build_make_m: build the mass matrix M = a @ b.T + diag(d) for a MuJoCo model with sparse or dense representation
create_mul_m: create a function that multiplies a vector by the inertia matrix of a MuJoCo model
test_jac: test the Jacobian computation for a global point attached to a body in a MuJoCo model
refactor_contact_force: refactor the contact force extraction to support both pyramidal and elliptic cone types
summarize_wrap: summarize the tendon wrap computation around sphere or cylinder geometry
